title: Voicemail
description: Phone screenshot of a visual-voicemail message with its automatic transcription (the printed companion to the TTS audio).

caller.description: Contact name as saved on the phone, or the number if unknown.

date.description: When the message was left, as the phone shows it.

transcript.description: Automatic transcription text. Lower-case slips and missing punctuation make it look real.
examples: Hi this is Tom Reilly calling from the news desk...
Fast-talking male TV producer, newsroom noise behind him

statusTime.description: Clock in the phone status bar.
